sections.section_title: Pipe1 and Pipe2 sharing image processing functions
sections.text_helper: Section 39.8.2 "Pipe1 and Pipe2 sharing image processing functions" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1872.
sections.section_content:
Following the application, it may be interesting to share the image processing functions
belonging to Pipe1 with Pipe2 when the dataflow is shared for both. One pipe may be used
for display operation, and the other one used for statistics or software analysis. In this case
PIPEDIFF bit of DCMIPP_P1FSCR register must be cleared.
If the CSI-2 module is connected to the DCMIPP, the VC DT and DTMODE of Pipe2 are the
same as those configured into DCMIPP_P1FSCR register, making non relevant the values
for these fields into the DCMIPP_P2FSCR register. However, bits CPTREQ and CPTMODE
remain active into the DCMIPP_P2FCTCR register to control the flow inside Pipe2.
